title: Localization of the ordinary affine tensor comparison
statement: Let R,A,R',A' be commutative rings, with R-algebra structures on A and R', and an algebra map from A tensor_R R' to A'. Let phi_g' and phi_f' be its restrictions and assume the corresponding spectrum square is cartesian. Let M be an A-K-flat cochain complex and m any BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A R' M A'. Put C=A' tensor_A M, U=A' tensor_(A tensor_R R') m.cohomology i, P=tilde M, and T=phi_g'^*P. The ordinary module arrow a0:U to H^i(C) is affineBaseChangeTildeModuleMap with identity target coordinates. At every prime p of A', let q be the canonical stalk model localizedComparison, followed by homology of tensorStalkIso, followed by the inverse affineRepresentativeStalkIso for T. Then there exists an additive equivalence lU:U_p to source(q) such that affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso(localize(a0)(x))=q(lU(x)) for all x. No derived representative K, its isomorphism e or inverse derived pullback counit occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Apply exists_affineOrdinaryTensorStalkCoordinates to obtain a chain isomorphism tau with its pure-tensor germ formula and its ordinary target-coordinate equation. Apply exists_affineLocalizedTensorStalkSquare to this tau and formula to obtain lU and the algebraic comparison square. For each x, rewrite the target coordinate by the first equation and the inner composite by the second. Evaluate the remaining ModuleCat compositions to identify the result with q(lU(x)). The target signature is unchanged and neither intermediate lemma restates it: the first has no derived source model or K-flatness, the second treats any germ-normalized chain isomorphism and ends at ordinary stalk-complex homology.

theorem exists_affineBaseChangeOrdinaryStalkComparison
    (R A R' A' : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R'] [CommRing A']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] R') A']
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R')]
    (φg' : A →+* A') (φf' : R' →+* A')
    (hφg' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) = φg')
    (hφf' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = φf')
    (sq : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} A) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M)
    (i : ℤ) (m : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A R' M A') :
    let P := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let C := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φg').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    let U := affineBaseChangeTildeModule R A R' A' M m i
    let a₀ := affineBaseChangeTildeModuleMap R A R' A' M m φg' hφg' i
      (C.homology i) (Iso.refl _)
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A',
      let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
      let f' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf')
      let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))
      let g' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')
      letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' p
      letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq p
      letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq p).toAlgebra
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p))
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p))
      let q := (SingleComplexBaseChange.cohomologyModel
        f f' g g' sq p P).localizedComparison i ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq p P).hom i ≫
          (affineRepresentativeStalkIso (Spec (.of A')) p T i).inv
      ∃ lU : LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl U ≃+ (Arrow.mk q).left,
        ∀ x, affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso A A' φg' M p i
          (LocalizedModule.map p.asIdeal.primeCompl a₀.hom x) = q (lU x)
